fitEvidence.caution: Top1 under gold histories plus full greedy canonical prefix reproduction corroborates memory, but not semantic understanding. Both directions fit, and cross-context NLL also falls, so lexical response memorization contributes.

heldasideEvidence.interpretation: No evidence of beneficial transfer within this previously supervised TRAIN pool. A versus B point differences cannot override the marked deterioration from the shared baseline. Context-gain interval includes zero.

freeGenerationMechanism.objectiveFact: assay_runtime.response_ce reproduces existing no-EOS, per-example mean response CE in eval mode. End-of-reply EOS receives no positive supervision in this diagnostic recipe.
freeGenerationMechanism.interpretation: A and B can replay the full memorized original target, then continue into repeated or broken text. Gold-prefix success cannot be counted as whole-generation success. Suppressed end EOS is a concrete proximal hypothesis, not proof that all repetition or semantic failures arise from EOS.
freeGenerationMechanism.heldasideCaution: Heldaside body NLL rises independently of EOS scoring; an EOS repair cannot be presumed to restore language retention or appropriate content.

validityLimits: Finite schedule context-dose imbalance:198 updates are24 full epochs plus48 cases.24 contexts have25vs24 exposures between arms; trajectory marginal matching is not exact. This limits uncontaminated one-factor causal claims, but does not erase the descriptive demonstration that both64 mappings can be fitted.
B contains plausible/ambiguous replies; it is a fixed non-original mapping, not uniformly false semantic labels. Primary all-row results and both-reviewers-clear supplementary rows are distinct.
Original64 pool is previously trained, anchor-selected RealPersona only. Heldaside excludes this assay updates and has speaker/family controls, but is not unseen generalization.
Only one fixed seed, existing Adam history, fixed small dose and greedy192 decoding were evaluated. No capacity/data/optimizer causal separation follows.

Blind assistant reading remains subjective; original candidates had been read before generation evaluation and could be remembered. Endpoint keys were not opened until heldaside annotations were complete.
Teacher/sequential errors and engineering stability checks support execution correctness; no new JavaScript inference equivalence is asserted.

priority.nextSmallOneFactorDiagnostic: Presence versus absence of an explicitly supervised end-of-reply EOS position, with body response CE and its normalization preserved exactly, from the same original R46 aligned full state.
priority.rationale: Both arms reproduce own targets16/16 but mostly overrun them, and gold-end EOS probabilities collapse. This provides a focused, testable stopping-boundary hypothesis before interpreting repeated suffixes as inability to learn the target.
fixedRequirements: Predeclare EOS term definition/coefficient, steps, data, Adam/RNG, body token exposure and generation criteria before any output; use equal complete-epoch context schedules.
No inferred early stopping, output truncation at gold length, punctuation repair, repetition penalty, R48 mass concentration or promotion of existing diagnostic weights.
Judge actual raw whole generation and heldaside body retention separately; stopping alone is not semantic generalization.
priority.expectedDiscrimination: If matched EOS supervision fixes target overrun while heldaside body NLL and content stay poor, stopping is one local mechanism and data/objective retention remains the larger problem. If it fails, self-history dynamics and optimization require further separation.
priority.broaderResearchPriority: Data distribution/learning allocation and retention of existing Japanese capabilities, ahead of blindly expanding capacity. The tiny repeated-only recipe can memorize both mappings but damages unupdated text, so the desirable objective and distribution matter.
priority.capacityPosition: Do not rule out insufficient capacity for broad generalization; successful64-pair memorization addresses only local capacity. Broader capacity-only comparisons remain justified after isolating boundary and retention issues.
